summary: The signed 32-bit source domain contains at most 32 binary digits, so the complete legal workload is too tightly bounded for an honest runtime-scaling verdict over bit length.

workload_bound.source_constraint: Both operands lie in the signed 32-bit interval, and the divisor is nonzero.

replacement_checks.evidence: The initial shift is at most 31, and the descending loop considers each shift through zero exactly once, so every legal call performs at most 32 bit-selection iterations with constant auxiliary state.
An independent truncation-and-clamp oracle checks 85,796 dense, boundary, and deterministic full-range random operand pairs against both app-local and immutable native sources.
